commentary_title: Firm demand in the Med likely to support freight rates next week
commentary_summary: The tonne miles index improved to 120.5 points in week 20 despite activity in the market starting off weak. Freight rates moderated on most routes however there were notabe gains towards the East and Med routes. | The tonnage underway rose towards the East with vessels headed most likely towards Indian West coast. Eastbound trade is likely to remain firm next week which will further support freight rates. | The trade in the West is expected to be supported by robust tonnage demand in the Med which is likely to attract more vessels in the region whilst supporting freight rates.
